render_contract.prefill: Render SOR extracts as candidates until reviewed. Preserve source text and locator; no exact-match claim from label similarity.
render_contract.missing: TBD or explicit open item; preserve intentional blank; do not replace false/0 with missing.
render_contract.applicability: Use selected device capabilities and variant; do not render unrelated branches.
render_contract.units: Numeric value, unit, comparator and conditions remain separate. Never copy incompatible units or historical defaults.
render_contract.branding: Use source header/footer layout with variable issuer and metadata; replace embedded logo while preserving bounds/aspect ratio. Do not copy environmental-procedure body.
render_contract.privacy: Contact/commercial fields only in profiles that need them; do not dump all customer data in every document.
render_contract.identity: Enquiry may exist before project; use enquiry ID and assigned project if available. Do not invent project IDs or approval names.
render_contract.progressive: Editable draft regenerates from its linked requirement version; preview changes. Signed/released versions remain immutable; changed baseline creates a new draft.
render_contract.completeness: A profile is customer-input-complete only when its applicable required inputs are resolved/reviewed. This is separate from technical completeness, test completion and approval.
render_contract.stages: Consume portal-defined deliverable/stage eligibility; no lifecycle configuration changes in this pack.
render_contract.release: No automatic release, signature, stage approval, feasibility acceptance, PASS, qualification or certificate claim.
